card.name: Partway through numbers and drug names
card.fires_on: Responds to the first digit of a number such as survival months or a dose, and to the middle pieces of drug names such as XOSPATA, LONSURF and hydrocodone. Also fires on a few linking words in headings or trial text.

modes.label: Leading digit of a number
modes.description: The first digit of a survival time, day count or isotope number in trial results or warnings.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or generic drug name or abbreviation, in instructions to discontinue or not escalate.

modes.label: Linking word in a heading or trial phrase
modes.description: A small word such as in or to inside a section heading or trial wording.
